Definition of done

How completion is verified

Implementation evidence

  • Task specification identifies the actual scope.
  • Code, tests, and linked PR/commit exist for the claimed behavior.
  • Subtasks are marked complete only when their evidence is available.

Validation evidence

  • Required tests and production build pass on the exact PR head.
  • Interactive behavior is browser-tested when relevant.
  • Deployment is verified separately; green CI alone is not deployment proof.

Status and acceptance criteria are maintained in tasks.json. Detailed scope and completion reports live in each task’s Markdown documents. A report template alone is not proof of completion.

Dionysus project ledger · Edit public/doc/tasks.json to update phases, task status, subtasks, acceptance criteria, and document links. The HTML is a renderer, not the task database.
